sentences.english: They are doing morning exercises in the park.
sentences.chinese: 他们正在公园里做早操。
sentences.scene: 清晨的公园里，一群老人伴着音乐缓缓活动身体。

sentences.english: My grandparents have been doing morning exercises together for over 20 years.
sentences.chinese: 我的爷爷奶奶一起做早操已经20多年了。
sentences.scene: 看着窗外楼下爷爷奶奶肩并肩打太极，感叹他们多年的坚持。

sentences.english: Every day at 7 a.m., you can see a group of people doing morning exercises by the lake. They move slowly and quietly, and it's a beautiful way to start the day.
sentences.chinese: 每天早上7点，你都能看到一群人在湖边做早操。他们的动作缓慢而安静，这是开启一天的美好方式。
sentences.scene: 晨跑时路过湖边，被这群专注锻炼的人所吸引。

sentences.english: We are having art class now.
sentences.chinese: 我们现在正在上美术课。
sentences.scene: 教室里，孩子们正拿着画笔认真地画画。

sentences.english: I can't talk right now because I'm having an online English class.
sentences.chinese: 我现在不能说话，因为我正在上英语网课。
sentences.scene: 朋友打来电话，你小声接听，指了指屏幕上的网课界面。

sentences.english: When the fire alarm went off, we were having a history class about ancient Rome. Everyone was so confused, but the teacher stayed calm and told us to leave quickly.
sentences.chinese: 火警响起时，我们正在上关于古罗马的历史课。大家都很困惑，但老师保持冷静，让我们迅速撤离。
sentences.scene: 学校消防演习，刺耳的警报声突然打断了生动的历史课。

sentences.english: She is eating lunch outside.
sentences.chinese: 她正在外面吃午饭。
sentences.scene: 天气好，同事在办公楼外的长椅上独自享用便当。

sentences.english: I was eating lunch at my desk when you called me earlier.
sentences.chinese: 你之前打电话来时，我正在办公桌前吃午饭。
sentences.scene: 中午边啃三明治边工作，突然接到电话。

sentences.english: We usually enjoy eating lunch together in the break room, sharing stories about our morning and laughing about silly mistakes we made.
sentences.chinese: 我们通常一起在休息室开心地吃午饭，分享早上的趣事，嘲笑自己犯的傻错。
sentences.scene: 公司休息室里，同事们围坐在一起，午饭时间充满欢声笑语。

sentences.english: He is reading a book under the tree.
sentences.chinese: 他正在树下看书。
sentences.scene: 校园草坪上，一个男生倚着树干专注地阅读。

sentences.english: On rainy weekends, I love reading a book on the sofa with a cup of hot tea.
sentences.chinese: 下雨的周末，我喜欢窝在沙发里，喝着热茶看书。
sentences.scene: 窗外细雨蒙蒙，你在客厅沙发上裹着毯子享受阅读时光。

sentences.english: Last night, I was reading a book that was so thrilling I couldn't put it down. I ended up finishing it at 3 a.m., and now I'm totally exhausted.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚我在看一本惊心动魄的书，根本停不下来。最后凌晨三点看完，现在我困得要命。
sentences.scene: 早上顶着黑眼圈跟朋友抱怨，昨晚又没忍住熬夜看小说了。

sentences.english: She is listening to music now.
sentences.chinese: 她正在听音乐。
sentences.scene: 地铁上，一个女孩戴着耳机，沉浸在自己的世界里。

sentences.english: I usually go for a run while listening to music. It gives me energy.
sentences.chinese: 我通常一边听音乐一边跑步。这会给我带来能量。
sentences.scene: 在公园跑步锻炼，耳朵里动感的节拍让你步伐轻盈。

sentences.english: Whenever I feel stressed, I spend an hour just lying on my bed, listening to music with my eyes closed. It's like a mini vacation for my brain.
sentences.chinese: 每当我感到压力大时，我就花一个小时躺在床上，闭着眼听音乐。这就像给大脑放了个迷你假期。
sentences.scene: 考完试或下班后疲惫不堪，关上房门用音乐给自己充电。

sentences.english: Please keep the door open.
sentences.chinese: 请让门开着。
sentences.scene: 搬家时两手抱着大箱子，对前面的人喊。

sentences.english: I keep all my old letters in this box under the bed.
sentences.chinese: 我把所有旧信件都保存在床底下的这个盒子里。
sentences.scene: 大扫除时从床底拉出一个铁盒，里面装满了青春回忆。

sentences.english: My grandmother told me to keep this ring safe, and I promised her I would never lose it. It's been in our family for generations.
sentences.chinese: 奶奶让我保管好这枚戒指，我向她保证绝不会弄丢。它在我们家已经传了好几代了。
sentences.scene: 抚摸着手指上的传家宝戒指，想起奶奶的嘱托。

sentences.english: Please keep to the right on the stairs.
sentences.chinese: 请在楼梯上靠右走。
sentences.scene: 学校楼梯口，老师提醒跑下楼的学生注意秩序。

sentences.english: When you're driving in this country, remember to keep to the right.
sentences.chinese: 在这个国家开车时，记得要靠右行驶。
sentences.scene: 在国外租车自驾，朋友坐在副驾驶提醒交通规则。

sentences.english: In the busy subway station, there's an announcement always reminding people to keep to the right on the escalator so that others can walk past on the left.
sentences.chinese: 在繁忙的地铁站，广播总是提醒人们在自动扶梯上靠右站立，以便其他人从左边通过。
sentences.scene: 高峰期的地铁站，扶梯上人们自觉站成一列，留下左侧通道。

sentences.english: Keep your desk clean, please.
sentences.chinese: 请保持桌面整洁。
sentences.scene: 放学前，班主任环视教室，点名提醒几个同学。

sentences.english: Our teacher always reminds us to keep our desks clean before we go home.
sentences.chinese: 我们老师总是提醒我们放学回家前要整理干净书桌。
sentences.scene: 放学铃响后，大家迅速收拾书包，不忘把桌子擦干净。

sentences.english: I never realized how much easier it is to focus when I keep my desk clean. Now I spend five minutes tidying it up every evening before I leave the office.
sentences.chinese: 我从未意识到保持桌面整洁能让注意力集中这么多。现在我每天下班前都会花五分钟收拾干净。
sentences.scene: 看着焕然一新的办公桌，满意地关灯下班。

sentences.english: Please talk quietly in the library.
sentences.chinese: 在图书馆里请轻声说话。
sentences.scene: 图书馆里，管理员把食指放在嘴边示意几个聊天的学生。

sentences.english: We had to talk quietly because the baby was sleeping in the next room.
sentences.chinese: 我们只得轻声说话，因为宝宝在隔壁房间睡觉。
sentences.scene: 客厅里，家人压低声音交流，生怕吵醒刚睡着的婴儿。

sentences.english: Even though we were at a fancy restaurant, the kids couldn't stop laughing. I had to remind them several times to talk quietly and not disturb the other guests.
sentences.chinese: 虽然我们在高级餐厅里，但孩子们还是忍不住大笑。我不得不几次提醒他们小声说话，别打扰其他客人。
sentences.scene: 西餐厅里，妈妈用严厉又无奈的眼神制止吵闹的孩子。

sentences.english: Turn left at the next corner.
sentences.chinese: 在下一个路口左转。
sentences.scene: 坐在副驾驶给开车的新手朋友指路。

sentences.english: Can you turn down the music a little? I'm on the phone.
sentences.chinese: 你能把音乐关小一点吗？我在打电话。
sentences.scene: 室友功放音乐太大声，你捂着手机话筒向他示意。

sentences.english: When you finish cooking the pancake, you have to flip it high in the air. But last time I tried to turn it, it ended up on the floor.
sentences.chinese: 煎饼煎好时，你得把它高高抛起翻个面。但我上次试着翻的时候，它掉到了地上。
sentences.scene: 厨房里一片狼藉，你看着地上的煎饼哭笑不得地讲述翻面失败的经历。

sentences.english: Let's take turns on the swing.
sentences.chinese: 我们轮流荡秋千吧。
sentences.scene: 公园游乐场里，两个小朋友商量着分享秋千。

sentences.english: My sister and I take turns washing the dishes after dinner.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭后，我和姐姐轮流洗碗。
sentences.scene: 厨房里，今天轮到你洗碗，姐姐在旁边擦桌子。

sentences.english: In our reading club, we take turns choosing the book for the month. This time it's my turn, and I picked a mystery novel that everyone seems excited about.
sentences.chinese: 在我们的读书俱乐部，我们轮流选每月读的书。这次轮到我了，我选了一本悬疑小说，大家似乎都很感兴趣。
sentences.scene: 读书会上，你兴奋地拿出自己选的书，观察大家的反应。

sentences.english: I bought a bamboo plant today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天买了一盆竹子。
sentences.scene: 从花市回来，开心地向室友展示新买的盆栽。

sentences.english: We planted some bamboo in the backyard, and now it's growing like crazy.
sentences.chinese: 我们在后院种了些竹子，现在它长得飞快。
sentences.scene: 看着后院墙角疯长的竹子，你担心它很快就会侵占整个院子。

sentences.english: The furniture in that shop is all made from bamboo. It looks simple and elegant, and it's also very good for the environment.
sentences.chinese: 那家店的家具全是用竹子做的。看起来简约又雅致，而且还很环保。
sentences.scene: 逛家居店时，被一套竹制桌椅吸引，向同行朋友安利。

sentences.english: The cat is licking its paws.
sentences.chinese: 那只猫正在舔它的爪子。
sentences.scene: 窗台上，猫咪饭后认真洗脸，样子呆萌。

sentences.english: The company is changing its logo. Have you seen the new design?
sentences.chinese: 那家公司要换它的标志了。你看到新设计了吗？
sentences.scene: 同事群里大家在热议公司换新Logo的事情。

sentences.english: That old tree in our yard is losing its leaves already, even though it's only early September. I hope it's okay.
sentences.chinese: 我们院里的那棵老树已经在落叶了，尽管现在才九月初。我希望它平安无事。
sentences.scene: 初秋的午后，你注意到院子里反常落叶，有些担忧。

sentences.english: Show me your new phone.
sentences.chinese: 给我看看你的新手机。
sentences.scene: 朋友买了新手机，你好奇地凑过去想看。

sentences.english: She showed me a photo of her puppy. It was adorable.
sentences.chinese: 她给我看了她家小狗的照片。可爱极了。
sentences.scene: 午饭时，同事拿出手机翻出宠物照片分享。

sentences.english: My favorite TV show just released a new season, and I've been watching it all weekend. I can't wait to see what happens next.
sentences.chinese: 我最爱的电视剧新一季刚出，我一整个周末都在看。等不及想知道接下来会发生什么了。
sentences.scene: 周一上班，顶着轻微的黑眼圈跟同事聊周末的追剧成果。

sentences.english: Do you need anything else?
sentences.chinese: 你还需要别的吗？
sentences.scene: 服务生在你点完餐后，微笑着询问。

sentences.english: Is there anything I can do to help you with the project?
sentences.chinese: 有什么我能帮你做这个项目的吗？
sentences.scene: 看到同事为项目忙得焦头烂额，你主动询问是否需要帮忙。

sentences.english: She's so picky about food that she barely eats anything at the party. I felt bad, so I ordered her a plain cheese pizza later.
sentences.chinese: 她对食物太挑剔了，在派对上几乎没吃任何东西。我觉得很过意不去，后来给她点了个原味芝士披萨。
sentences.scene: 派对结束后，你单独给没吃饱的朋友点外卖。

sentences.english: Who else is coming to dinner?
sentences.chinese: 还有谁要来吃晚饭？
sentences.scene: 你在布置餐桌，问准备下厨的室友晚上的聚会规模。

sentences.english: I don't want this one. Do you have anything else in blue?
sentences.chinese: 我不喜欢这件。你们还有别的蓝色的吗？
sentences.scene: 在服装店试衣服，不太满意手上的款式，向店员求助。

sentences.english: After we finished the main course, the waiter asked if we wanted anything else. We were so full, but we still decided to share a dessert.
sentences.chinese: 我们吃完主菜后，服务生问还想来点什么别的吗。我们明明很饱了，但还是决定合吃一份甜点。
sentences.scene: 餐厅里，虽然吃撑了，但翻开甜品单又忍不住食指大动。

sentences.english: The art exhibition opens tomorrow.
sentences.chinese: 艺术展明天开幕。
sentences.scene: 看到海报上写着开展日期，你兴奋地记在备忘录上。

sentences.english: We went to a dinosaur exhibition at the museum last weekend. The kids loved it.
sentences.chinese: 上周末我们去博物馆看了恐龙展。孩子们喜欢极了。
sentences.scene: 周末亲子活动，巨大的恐龙骨架下孩子们惊叹不已。

sentences.english: There's a photography exhibition downtown that features pictures of abandoned buildings from around the world. It's both beautiful and a little sad.
sentences.chinese: 市中心有个摄影展，展出世界各地废弃建筑的照片。那些作品很美，但又带点伤感。
sentences.scene: 你在安静的画廊里驻足，面前是一张破败剧院的黑白照片。

sentences.english: What did you say?
sentences.chinese: 你刚才说什么？
sentences.scene: 周围环境太吵，你侧过耳朵让朋友再说一遍。

sentences.english: My grandma always used to say, "An apple a day keeps the doctor away."
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶过去总说：“一天一苹果，医生远离我。”
sentences.scene: 你拿起一个苹果，想起了奶奶的口头禅。

sentences.english: It's hard to say goodbye to a place you've lived in for ten years. I stood in the empty living room, trying to remember every little moment.
sentences.chinese: 很难向一个住了十年的地方说再见。我站在空荡荡的客厅里，努力记住每一个细小的瞬间。
sentences.scene: 搬家前的最后一天，环顾四周，心中满是不舍。

sentences.english: Let me have a look at that.
sentences.chinese: 让我看看那个。
sentences.scene: 朋友手机出了故障，你伸手接过去准备检查一下。

sentences.english: I'm not sure what's wrong with your computer. Can I have a look?
sentences.chinese: 我不确定你电脑出了什么问题。我能看一下吗？
sentences.scene: 同事电脑死机求助，你挽起袖子准备一探究竟。

sentences.english: When we went to the open house, we had a look around every room. The kitchen was so beautiful that I immediately started imagining myself cooking there.
sentences.chinese: 我们去参观待售房时，把每个房间都看了一遍。厨房漂亮极了，我立马开始想象自己在那里做饭的情景。
sentences.scene: 跟房产中介看房，走进厨房后两眼放光，已经开始幻想未来的生活。

sentences.english: I love sushi for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 我午饭喜欢吃寿司。
sentences.scene: 在便利店选购午餐，毫不犹豫地拿了一盒寿司拼盘。

sentences.english: Let's go to that new sushi place downtown. I heard it's really fresh.
sentences.chinese: 我们去市中心那家新开的寿司店吧。听说那里的食材特别新鲜。
sentences.scene: 约朋友吃饭，你兴致勃勃地提议去打卡网红寿司店。

sentences.english: The first time I tried sushi, I was a little nervous about eating raw fish. But now it's one of my favorite foods, and I could eat it every day.
sentences.chinese: 第一次尝寿司时，我对于吃生鱼还有点紧张。但现在它是我最爱的美食之一，天天吃我都愿意。
sentences.scene: 在日料店熟练地用筷子夹起一块三文鱼，想起了当年那个不敢下口的自己。

sentences.english: Can you teach me this song?
sentences.chinese: 你能教我这首歌吗？
sentences.scene: 听到一首好听的曲子，你拉着会乐器的朋友想学。

sentences.english: My dad taught me how to ride a bike when I was five.
sentences.chinese: 我五岁时，爸爸教会了我骑自行车。
sentences.scene: 看到小区里学车的孩子，想起了自己小时候父亲在身后扶着车座的情景。

sentences.english: I volunteered to teach English to kids at the community center last summer. It was challenging but also incredibly rewarding to see them improve.
sentences.chinese: 去年暑假，我志愿在社区中心教小孩子英语。虽然很有挑战性，但看到他们进步，收获感也满满的。
sentences.scene: 暑假结束时的最后一堂课，孩子们围着你送小卡片，你感动不已。

sentences.english: Are you sure about this?
sentences.chinese: 这件事你确定吗？
sentences.scene: 朋友做了个冲动的决定，你一脸担忧地再次确认。

sentences.english: I'm not sure if I locked the door. Let me go back and check.
sentences.chinese: 我不确定我锁没锁门。我得回去看看。
sentences.scene: 刚开车出小区，你突然强迫症发作，准备掉头回家确认。

sentences.english: When my friend asked me to help him move, I said, "Sure, no problem." Later I realized he lived on the fifth floor with no elevator, and I regretted it a little.
sentences.chinese: 朋友叫我帮忙搬家时，我说：“没问题，当然可以。”后来我发现他住五楼且没电梯，我稍微有点后悔。
sentences.scene: 站在堆满箱子的楼道里，你气喘吁吁地擦着汗，后悔自己答应得太爽快。

sentences.english: She is a Canadian teacher.
sentences.chinese: 她是一位加拿大老师。
sentences.scene: 班上来了位新外教，你向同桌介绍她的国籍。

sentences.english: I'm planning a trip to the Canadian Rockies next summer. It looks stunning.
sentences.chinese: 我正计划明年夏天去加拿大落基山脉旅行。看起来美极了。
sentences.scene: 你在网上看到绝美的风景照，开始兴致勃勃地做旅行攻略。

sentences.english: Growing up in a small Canadian town, we used to play hockey on the frozen lake every winter. It was freezing, but we had so much fun that we never wanted to go inside.
sentences.chinese: 在加拿大小镇长大的时候，我们每个冬天都在结冰的湖面上打冰球。天冷极了，但我们玩得太开心，谁都不想回家。
sentences.scene: 温暖的壁炉旁，你翻看老照片，回忆童年加拿大的快乐冬天。

sentences.english: She can speak Spanish fluently.
sentences.chinese: 她能流利地说西班牙语。
sentences.scene: 聚会上，一位朋友用西语跟人聊天，旁人都很佩服。

sentences.english: I'm learning Spanish on an app. It's hard, but I practice every day.
sentences.chinese: 我正在一个手机应用上学西班牙语。挺难的，但我每天都练。
sentences.scene: 利用通勤时间在App上闯关打卡，嘴里念念有词。

sentences.english: When I traveled to Barcelona, I realized my Spanish wasn't as good as I thought. But the locals were really patient and helped me order food by pointing at pictures.
sentences.chinese: 去巴塞罗那旅行时，我才意识到我的西班牙语没自己想的那么好。但当地人特别有耐心，帮着我指图片点餐。
sentences.scene: 在巴塞罗那街边小餐馆，你对着菜单一脸茫然，服务员笑着用手势帮你解围。
